thread:
sam: Quick sync 0:30 PT - planning a conservative blue/green sway for router v4.3.0. Objective: validate LB weight matrix, keep session affinity, and have regional evac plan ready. Change window 20:15-22:15 PT. No other router ops.

anya: Ack. I'll own the dashboards/watch and slack post updates. Who's doing the warmup and which regions are probed first?

sam: Warmup runs at 20:15 PT. Initial probe cohort = 5% (us-west + asia-south mixed). I'll run warmup script.

chris: Release notes: https://go.redwood/release/4.3.0 19: new conn pooling fallback + LB weight fairness fix. Routing commands for the run: `routerctl set-weights --version=4.3.0 --weights=\"global:5\" --enable-affinity --affinity-ttl=3600`

kevin: Proposed cadence: 5% (7m), 12% (8m), 30% (12m), 60% (10m), 100% (6m). Pause and validate at each step: p95, 5xx-rate, queue_depth, and region-specific 4xx/5xx.

maria: Suggest rollback triggers: sustained p95 > 220ms for 4m OR 5xx_rate > 0.5% for 3m OR any region with 5xx > 2.5x baseline. Also check KVS prefix hit drop > 15%.

oncall-sre: I'll run warmup and watch asia nodes closely. Post warmup command pls.

sam: Warmup command (kicking off 20:15 PT):
```
./ops/warmup_kv.sh --svc router --ver 4.3.0 --concurrency 10 --duration 14m
```

deploy-bot: PRE-FLIGHT OK 0:10 PT 12 infra checks passed, autoscaler headroom 26%, canary tests green.

deploy-bot: WARMUP STARTED 0:15 PT warming prefix caches for router v4.3.0 (initiated by sam)

deploy-bot: TRAFFIC STEP: 5% -> green (v4.3.0). ts: 1759999000. Monitor: dashboard/router/p95 and dashboard/router/5xx_rate

anya: Watching. p95 108ms, 5xx 0.02%, affinity hit-rate OK. :eyes:

chris: Rollback pin command (runbook): `routerctl pin --version 4.2.3 --reason \"auto-rollback\"`

deploy-bot: TRAFFIC STEP: 12% -> green (v4.3.0). ts: 1759999260. Health checks: OK.

oncall-sre: Small queue_depth rise in asia-south (approx +15%). Kicking an intra-region soak and temporarily demoting worker concurrency there.

sam: Hold at 12% if asia-south doesn't stabilize in 6m. If still up, we'll exclude asia-south and continue with other regions.

kevin: If we need a soft rollback for a region use: `routerctl demote-region --region=asia-south --keep-affinity` then re-balance weights.

deploy-bot: TRAFFIC STEP: 30% -> green (v4.3.0). ts: 1759999360. Checks: p95 120ms, 5xx 0.04%, queue_depth trending down after soak.

maria: Metrics acceptable. Proceed with 60% when ready. Logging rollback conditions in runbook.

deploy-bot: TRAFFIC STEP: 60% -> green (v4.3.0). ts: 1759999420. Health: OK.

anya: Starting post-deploy watch. I'll keep updates here until 22:15 PT and file a short note in #postmortems if any follow-ups.

deploy-bot: TRAFFIC STEP: 100% -> green (v4.3.0). ts: 1759999460. Final: p95 116ms, 5xx 0.03%, affinity-stable.

sam: TL;DR: staged sway succeeded, session affinity enabled, regional evacuation knob documented. Rollback pins and demote-region commands added to runbook. Thanks all. :party_parrot:

maria: I'll schedule a quick follow-up to re-check quantization flags and kernel selection effects in the next maintenance window.

anya: Final ACK 21:40 PT stable across regions. :white_check_mark:
